content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm new to PLCs and I want to use my PLC to monitor and control pressure using the [product_name] display. I tried working with the mathematical block, but I couldn't get the desired results. If anyone can assist me, I would greatly appreciate it. Best regards, [user_name]
Could you specify what you want to control? Are you aiming to adjust a limit value? More detailed information would be helpful.

Hello, Thank you for responding, [user_name]. Let me describe my setup briefly. I'm planning to create an automated pulse switching circuit where I need to monitor pressure and pulses. Instead of a function generator, I want to use my [company_name] PLC to generate the pulse (between 50mHz and 2Hz). Once the operation completes a set time (for instance, 60 minutes), it should automatically stop the pulse and then turn off the pressure inlet using a solenoid valve.
I hope I understood your requirements correctly. Attached is a solution that I suggest.

analysis.insight_summary: Participants are discussing how to use a [company_name] PLC and [product_name] display to monitor pressure and perform pulse generation for automation. The main user, a beginner, is looking for help with setting up mathematical blocks and configuring the device to control a solenoid valve based on time and pressure feedback.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for a straightforward, beginner-friendly way to set up pulse generation, pressure monitoring, and timed automation using a [company_name] PLC and [product_name] display, and expects sufficient guidance for configuration.
